notes: Numerator and denominator must use the same business unit and scope.
A missing or zero denominator is N_A, never an automatic 100 percent.
Pass thresholds and progress percentage are separate concepts.
Risk-count and information metrics do not receive a synthetic percentage.

current.knownGap: Attendance rows and patrol dates are different units, so the result is capped to 100 without representing completion.

target.numerator: eligible completed attendance slots due in the selected year window
target.denominator: required roster attendance slots due in the same year window
target.formula: completed eligible slots / required eligible slots

current.calculation: (current-year reports - all open reports) / current-year reports
current.knownGap: The open count is not constrained to the same year as the total.

target.numerator: distinct current Admin assignments whose employee has at least one non-deleted closed report in the selected year
target.denominator: all current Hiyari assignments configured by Admin
target.formula: assigned employees with a closed current-year report / current Admin assignments

current.knownGap: Department percentages are unweighted and a fallback target of 12 is used when configuration is absent.

target.numerator: eligible KY activities in configured Department and Safety Unit scopes
target.denominator: sum of active configured Safety Unit yearly targets
target.formula: sum eligible activities / sum configured targets

current.calculation: current-year permanent completions / all assignment rows
current.knownGap: Completion year and assignment population are not explicitly aligned to one active scope.

target.numerator: completed permanent assignees in the current eligible assignment population

current.knownGap: Responding Departments and topics are different units and topic assignment scope is not represented.

target.numerator: distinct assigned Department-topic pairs with a valid non-deleted response
target.denominator: distinct Department-topic pairs assigned by topic Department scope

current.calculation: sum PassedCount / sum TotalEmp for the selected year
current.knownGap: The mathematics is aligned, but the business population may contain repeated employees across Department or course records.

target.numerator: capped passed employee count in current-year Department records
target.denominator: total employee count in the same current-year Department records

current.calculation: current-year report count with recordable count as the risk signal
current.knownGap: A card without a percentage defaults to On Track unless an explicit alert is present.

current.calculation: closed current-year notices / all current-year notices
current.knownGap: The closure formula is aligned, but PHP returns Training Required and matrix counts as hardcoded zero values.

target.numerator: closed change notices in the selected year
target.denominator: all eligible change notices in the selected year

current.calculation: current-year KPI row count with all announcement rows
current.knownGap: Announcement scope is not limited to the current announcement and information cards default to On Track.
The card does not calculate current-policy acknowledgement coverage against the employee population, and PHP counts all acknowledgements.

target.numerator: distinct employees acknowledging the current policy
target.denominator: employees required to acknowledge the current policy

current.knownGap: Historical and current committee records are counted together and the information card defaults to On Track.

current.calculation: active machine count with open issue and critical-risk counts
current.knownGap: The card has no compliance percentage, and PHP critical count does not consistently exclude inactive machines.

target.numerator: passing checked compliance items on active machines
target.denominator: checked non-N/A compliance items on active machines
target.formula: passing checked items / checked non-N/A items

current.calculation: arithmetic average of latest Department coverage values with overdue values capped at 50
current.knownGap: The displayed percentage mixes completion and overdue risk, and Department percentages are unweighted.

target.numerator: sum of capped attained participants from the latest eligible Department records
target.denominator: sum of positive yearly targets from the same records
target.formula: sum attained toward target / sum target

current.calculation: all document rows with documents uploaded in the last 30 days
current.knownGap: The all-time count is mixed with a rolling window and the information card defaults to On Track.

target.numerator: documents in the explicitly labelled reporting scope

current.knownGap: The card does not expose the real assessment or PPE compliance percentage and defaults to On Track.

target.numerator: sum of non-null normalized assessment topic scores
target.denominator: count of non-null assessment topic scores multiplied by 100
target.formula: sum normalized topic scores / maximum available score
